statistical_methodology_note: In Stage 3B on IQM Emerald (01a1b85a-f7ea-70b1-baaf-ba5e17e92178), M3 (4 PUBs), M4 (4 PUBs in G00..G03), and M5 (4 PUBs in G00..G03) have K = 4 disjoint physical-PUB clusters (df = 3). However, M1 packed the 8 Short workloads into only K = 2 physical 4-Way PUBs (M1_IQM_SS_0 for G00+G01, M1_IQM_SS_1 for G02+G03) and M2 packed the 8 Long workloads into K = 2 physical 4-Way PUBs (M2_IQM_LL_0, M2_IQM_LL_1). Therefore, when accounting for shared physical-PUB execution in M1 and M6, there are only K = 2 completely independent physical-PUB clusters (C0 and C1, df = 1). Both physical-PUB clusters show positive M1 vs M4 wait-loss recovery (+0.0088 F_B in C0 and +0.0426 F_B in C1 across all M4 pairings, mean +0.0257 F_B = 59.7% recovery; or +0.0154 F_B in C0 and +0.0351 F_B in C1 vs disjoint M4 G00..G03, mean +0.0252 F_B), but with K = 2 clusters (df = 1, t_crit_95 = 6.314), formal statistical certification is withheld (1-sided superiority p = 0.1850 / 0.1187 at K = 2, df = 1; vs. p = 0.0488 under unclustered N = 8 workloads).
